::: {.minipage data-latex="{\textwidth}"}
### `RemoveImageGutterShadow` {-}

Lightens the dark shadow that appears near the gutter (i.e., spine) of a scanned book page and saves the result to another image file.
Returns true if image was successfully saved.

#### Syntax {-}

``` {.lua}
boolean RemoveImageGutterShadow(string inputImagePath,
                                string outputImagePath,
                                GutterSide side,
                                number gutterWidthProportion)
```


#### Return value {-}

Type: `boolean`

#### Parameters {-}

**Parameter** | **Description**
| :-- | :-- |
| `string` inputImagePath | The input image. |
| `string` outputImagePath | Where to save the image. |
| [`GutterSide`](#gutterside) side | Which side of the image the gutter is on. |
| `number` gutterWidthProportion | (Optional) The proportion (from `0.0` to `1.0`) of the image's width over which the correction tapers off.<br>\linebreak Default is `0.15`. |


:::
